scope: Rust target storage for immutable VerifiedIR structure and inductive fields
representation: Generated fields use std::rc::Rc<T> instead of Box<T>. Derived Clone shares each stored field; constructors allocate a new shared field, projections and pattern bindings copy only the accessed value. VerifiedIR remains target-independent.
reason: Box<T>::clone clones its pointee. Derived Clone over recursive Box fields therefore copied entire syntax/list trees during ordinary variable use, calls, captures and pattern matching. Rc clone increments ownership without recursively cloning the pointee.
compatibility: Generated Rust source field types change from Box<T> to Rc<T>. External Rust code manually constructing fields must use Rc::new. External VerifiedIR imports still reject; no new foreign ABI is implied. Rc is single-threaded; no Send/Sync or thread-safe sharing contract is claimed.
remaining: stack-safe final-owner destruction of deep trees
global target preservation proof or independent validator
focusedEvidence: Lean emitter/source tests, the full portable executable contract and Rust metadata type checking pass.
